thread:
maria: Heads up — Marketplace reported a SKU-level mismatch on the reserved packs for the EU Dedicated pools this week. RU-4306 in the vendor portal looks like the root.
alex: Seen that. Summary from vendor: manifest showed 2x `r5-gpu-48` reserved but on our side the reservation system created 1x `r5-gpu-48` and 1x `r5-gpu-48-legacy` (SKU aliasing).
raj: That aliasing will break routing and cause double-counting in our quota engine. We just flagged a customer commit that now looks under-reserved.
sophie: Is this coming from the SI onboarding sheet or the cloud marketplace sync?
maria: Marketplace -> vendor mapping. SI hasn't touched these SKUs yet but could be impacted when they try to claim capacity for pilot clusters.
orion-bot: [info] Ticket RU-4306 updated by vendor at 2026-02-18T09:12:03Z — provided manifest CSV and invoice stub.
alex: Quick triage: vendor CSV uses `sku_code` column, sometimes includes suffixes for firmware packs. Our ingest normalizer currently strips dashes but not suffix tokens. Example from CSV: `r5-gpu-48-legacy`, `r5-gpu-48`.
raj: Proposed short-term fix: run a one-off reconciliation job that maps `*-legacy` -> canonical `r5-gpu-48` and adjusts reservation counts. Impact window: ~30s to compute, 30m to validate, non-disruptive if we don't change live routes until validation done.
sophie: Can we do the reconciliation and then gate a CS/SE announcement so SIs don't start claiming the legacy SKUs? Need a simple customer-facing note.
maria: Agreed. Action items: (1) alex to kick off reconciliation job and capture delta, (2) raj to draft quota-adjust script and dry-run, (3) sophie to prep a short marketplace notice and SI heads-up.

alex: Starting job now. Command I'm running: `python infra/tools/sku_reconcile.py --source vendor_ru4306.csv --map suffix_to_canonical=true --dry-run` — will post results in 15m.
raj: I'll prepare the quota patch: `PATCH /resv/v1/adjust` with body `{ "sku":"r5-gpu-48", "delta": <n> }` and a safety flag `notify=false` for dry-run.
sophie: Draft note to partners: "We identified a SKU aliasing issue affecting reservation counts in EU Dedicated pools. We're reconciling counts now and will post a confirmation when done. Please pause claiming any `*-legacy` SKUs until you hear back." Thoughts?
maria: Perfect. Also CC legal & finance if invoice stubs mismatch after reconciliation. alex, please include a CSV of the reconciliation results.
alex: Reconcile dry-run complete — summary: canonical `r5-gpu-48` expected 120, vendor manifest sum=122 (including 2 legacy). Our active reservations 118. Delta if we canonicalize: +4 to canonical and remove 2 legacy entries -> net +2 reservations. Uploading `recon_ru4306_3312345678.csv` to /shared/partnerships/recon/ now.
orion-bot: [info] File uploaded: /shared/partnerships/recon/recon_ru4306_3312345678.csv
raj: Dry-run of quota patch shows safe delta +2. I can run the patch at 10:30 UTC with a rollback plan. If anyone sees objections speak now.
sophie: No objections. I'll schedule the partner note for 10:40 UTC to give you a 10-minute buffer.
maria: OK go ahead with patch and then announce. After patch, we should schedule a quick 20m async postmortem to lock down where aliasing originates and add a canonicalization step in marketplace ingest.
alex: Patching in 5. Running `PATCH /resv/v1/adjust` with `notify=true` now.
alex: Patch complete. Response: 200 OK. Reservations updated +2 canonical, legacy SKUs removed from active reservations list.
raj: Verified. Routing now sees 120 canonical active. No HTTP errors in the check suite. Rolling metrics look normal.
sophie: Announcement sent to partners and SI leads: "Reconciliation applied, pause lifted for claiming canonical SKUs. Reach out if you see any delta." Link: https://partners.redwood.ai/announcements/RU-4306
maria: Thanks team. Follow-ups: raj to add ingest canonicalization ticket, alex to add automated reconciliation as a nightly check, sophie to track any partner-reported downstream issues. I'll open a short retro doc.
raj: Created ticket INF-7729 for canonicalization, assigned to eng-ml.
alex: Added job to ops-runbook and flagged for monitoring.
sophie: Putting retro doc in /shared/partnerships/retros/RU-4306-3312345678.md :thumbsup:
maria: Closing thread here unless someone sees an outstanding issue. :wave:
